review: independent focused source review; reused reviewer seat; zero D43 authorship

live_outcome.evidence: No browser or runtime execution in this review. The prior D39 live session reproduced the nested-scope takeover when adding fields, but it predates this proposed patch and is not evidence that the patch works.
live_outcome.claim_limit: No claim that the proposed implementation was installed, exercised, or accepted live.

source_verdict.status: not ready; core seeded continuation is disconnected

confirmed_blocker.reproduction: With an existing broad list configuration, invoke Pick more fields and click a nested title. Expected: reuse the existing list_root/item_selector and collect a field. Actual in the prepared patch: ListPatternTab still calls startListPickerSession(tab.id, sessionId) without a seed (current source line 347); therefore mountListPicker receives no seed and remains in phase 'item'. A nested repeated li can still replace the broad card scope.
confirmed_blocker.evidence: The patch adds seed support to list-picker-session.ts and mountListPicker(), but does not change the ListPatternTab enterPicker call. src/entrypoints/list-picker.content.ts assigns mountListPicker directly as the start hook. The prepared first regression directly calls mountListPicker(id, seed), bypassing the missing sidepanel-to-session-to-content wiring, so it would not catch this integration failure.

positive_source_changes: Fresh clicks can enumerate repeated ancestor candidates and defer item-detected until a scope is selected.
Field clicks are resolved against the repeated item containing the click, and config merging now requires both root and item selector to match.
The proposed scope selection message carries the current picker session ID, consistent with D42's identity check if the rest of the D42 transport is retained.
additional_proof_gaps: The prepared regression's runPickedPattern uses the same first rel_selector for both title and URL; it does not prove distinct field selection or that adding fields appends to the prior saved/exploratory configuration.

The direct mount tests do not exercise startListPickerSession serialization, injected hook invocation, D42 stamped rebroadcast, or sidepanel acceptance/merge; no regression proves the user-visible continuation end to end.
The no-seed page-change test proves only a fresh picker run; it does not assert stale A completion cannot overwrite replacement B during seeded mount, cancel, or delayed injection.
source_verdict.d42_lifecycle: No direct identity regression is visible in the patch: emitted messages retain session_id and the existing D42 consumer filters tab, session, and page key. However seed transport is not wired at the caller, and async injection/cancel overlap with the new seed path is not covered by the prepared regression.

review_scope: Read-only inspection of the proposed diff, prepared test, current ListPatternTab caller, picker content hook, and selector inference. Patch was not applied; tests/build/browser were not run.
